GOOD TO KNOW

Before you start.

Which app should I choose?

Choose OnlyBody for bodyweight-focused workouts. Choose OnlyWeights for gym sessions with free weights, cables and machines. You can use both; each app keeps its own routines and history.

Do the apps work offline?

Workout planning, recording sets and viewing saved history work on your device. YouTube demonstrations and external links need an internet connection.

Does OnlyBody need equipment?

Many exercises use no equipment. Some variations need a bar, support or other equipment. Each exercise lists what it requires.

Are the apps available yet?

Both apps are coming soon for iPhone with iOS 26 or later. App Store links will appear here at launch.

Is there a subscription?

The current apps have no subscriptions or in-app purchases. Launch pricing will be shown on the App Store.
